name: runtime-viewer
description: Teaches coding agents to drive runtime-viewer-cli: Objective-C and Swift interfaces, class hierarchies and member addresses read from a live runtime — this Mac, Mac Catalyst, attached processes and Bonjour peers.

interface.shortDescription: ObjC and Swift interfaces from a live runtime
interface.longDescription: How to drive runtime-viewer-cli, the command-line tool inside RuntimeViewer.app: images, types, search, interface, hierarchy, relationships, members, specialize and export against the local runtime, Mac Catalyst, attached processes or Bonjour peers; how image, type and source names resolve; the --json and exit-status contract; and the background host. Requires RuntimeViewer 3.0.0-beta.5 or later, which ships the tool inside the app.
